title: verify_slot_claim lacks domain separation prefix validation
description: In trust.rs, verify_key_rotation validates the KEY_ROTATE: prefix (lines 165-170) for domain separation to prevent confused deputy attacks, but verify_slot_claim does NOT validate any prefix. This is asymmetric and allows cross-context signature replay: a valid key rotation message+signature could be accepted by verify_slot_claim since it only checks message length and signature verification. The slot claim test vector shows messages should start with SLOT_CLAIM: prefix (534c4f545f434c41494d3a), but this is not enforced. Fix: add prefix validation similar to verify_key_rotation, checking message.starts_with(b"SLOT_CLAIM:") and appropriate length bounds.
close_reason: Fixed: Added SLOT_CLAIM: prefix validation to verify_slot_claim for domain separation parity with verify_key_rotation. Also added trust module export to lib.rs (was orphaned). Three tests added: slot_claim_rejects_key_rotation_message, slot_claim_rejects_wrong_prefix.
